releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.30 - Screen Touch Lock, ML Rapid Hits & Ad Data Reconciliation
releaseNotes:
* Screen Touch Lock (Pocket Protection Mode): Block hand & pocket touches with double-tap anywhere unlock
* Ad-skipping data reconciliation: clean single-session lifecycle with zero orphaned running sessions
* Floating HUD bubble & In-App screen synchronization: synchronized Pause/Resume and auto-close on Stop
* On-Device ML/AI Rapid Hits: automatic pattern persistence into Room DB and instant hit recording
* Fast-Path Click Dispatch: 50-100ms ultra-rapid action on learned ad patterns
* 4x accelerated visual perception interval (250ms cadence) with 12-bit Hamming tolerance
